messages:
lucy: Heads-up: console shows p95 > p99 for an endpoint breakdown (edge-proxy cohort). looks like a quantile inversion on the pctl tiles.
omar: can you paste the slice / query you used? small-sample artifacts are common.
lucy: query: ```select percentile(0.95, duration_ms), percentile(0.99, duration_ms), count(*) from requests where endpoint='/v1/complete' and cohort='edge-proxy' and time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'```
lucy: count=18, p95=480ms, p99=360ms.
tess: that screams tdigest merge with mixed compression or legacy rollups. telemetry changed compression in Feb, right?
telemetry-bot: rollup_meta: codec=tdigest, compression=60 for shard-A, compression=100 for shard-B; compression mismatch seen 2026-02-11 through 2026-03-01.
ravi: two quick mitigation ideas: (1) UI shows a low-sample warning (n<50) and collapses percentiles into a raw-sample inspector; (2) telemetry emits rollup headers (compression, epoch, variant) so UI can detect mixed merges.
tess: agree. long-term: produce a normalized rollup_variant (stable_compression) and backfill for priority endpoints. short-term: show a provenance pill and warn when shard compression differs.
omar: also check if retries were folded in. retried requests inflate tails; we should show retry_ratio in tooltip.
telemetry-bot: note: is_retry field indexed 2026-03-22T04:12:00Z and retry_counts available in recent rollups. older rollups may include retries implicitly.
lucy: ok — for immediate triage I'll add the raw inspector and low-sample tooltip. please file telemetry ticket to add rollup headers and schedule a backfill for top endpoints.
ravi: I'll file console#3012 (low-sample warning + raw inspector) and telemetry#3013 (rollup headers + normalized rollup backfill).
tess: UX copy suggestion for the pill: "Provenance: mixed rollup codecs — percentiles may be unreliable for n<50. View raw samples".
lucy: thanks. once telemetry tickets land I'll re-check and move the dashboard card to in-progress. end of thread.
